description:
The Bazecor configurator software allows you to remap any key and create up to 10 fully programmable layers for your Dygma Raise keyboard. It also allows you to create and manage superkeys, macros, and shortcuts.


Hi, everyone!
Today, we have a very exciting release, because we're introducing Layer Lens, a feature that lets you activate an overlay of your current layer on your computer screen.
You can resize it, adjust its transparency, show or hide it with the new Layer Lens keys, and even make it appear only when you change layers.
Screenshot_2026-08-05_at_18 43 58
This first version of Dygma Lens is only available for the Dygma Sonsei and for English US layouts (you need to update the firmware to v1.1.0), but we're working on porting it to the Defy and the Raise 2, as well as more languages.
Once you have installed Bazecor and updated the firmware, you can activate it and adjust your preferences in Settings > Layer Lens.
Please carefully read the instructions you'll find there.
Let us know what you think!
What's new from v1.9.2
- Fixed a bug where the Superkey limit warning was shown at 50, when the limit is 70
- Removed outdated videos from the Macros and Superkeys menu
- Merged PRs to improve tests
- Changed the Settings page title from Preferences to Settings
